incidents.name: Thetanuts
incidents.notes: Same Thetanuts index-vault flaw: flash-borrow shares, claim to crush totalSupply, then free-mint via integer-division truncation to repay and keep component vaults.

sources.ref: onchain review of the exploit tx: the attack contract's net gain is 105,471.4991 USDC plus 33,593.77 TN-CSCPv1 vault shares (AVAXUSD/BNBUSD/MATICUSD). The ~$2.1M figure circulating for this incident is the at-risk amount, of which ~$2M was rescued by a whitehat, so it is not the realised loss; the duplicate thetanutsfi row carrying that figure was removed

incidents.name: Thetanuts BTC/USD covered-call vault first-depositor rounding
incidents.notes: The BTC/USD covered-call vault still held ~0.15 WBTC while its share totalSupply had fallen to zero, so a flash-loaned two-step deposit (2 satoshis, then 4.68 WBTC) rounded the attacker into effectively all outstanding shares and initWithdraw() redeemed the vault's whole WBTC balance.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim vault created 2022-05-27 by 0x4a4c7c5549359b9fff0137bb3ec4d48c4aa79cc7 (not the attacker), unverified source, no EIP-1967 Upgraded events before the incident. Distinct contract and incident from the 2026-06-15 Thetanuts index-vault hack already in this file. DefiLlama records $50,000 (First Depositor Attack, Ethereum); Defimon reported $46K.
